about: ADR 0153 / ADR 0167: the only hosts the module installer may reach, on consent. The sole package host is Cloudflare R2 behind modules.qrtz.ai (no Backblaze B2 mirror). root1Sha256 pins v1/root/1.root.json; null until the offline root keys exist (docs/modules/hosting-setup.md), and while it is null every network install is refused. modelMirrors are the only hosts a signed tree's extra mirror URL may point at (ADR 0157: a model file's pinned Hugging Face URL, checked by the same sha256 through the same fetcher). crates/qrtz-lifecycle/tests/offline_graph.rs checks this file.
